summary: Danaos Corporation filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, containing its proxy statement for the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. The meeting is scheduled for July 31, 2026, in Piraeus, Greece. Agenda items include election of two Class II directors and ratification of independent auditors. No special-situation corporate actions are disclosed. This is a routine annual meeting filing with no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation activity.
